_: The rule registry of the org (krizaka/.github#393): every org rule that must hold in every active repository, with the check that proves it. scripts/conformance.mjs runs it against repos.json (repo x rule). A rule without a check does not pass tests/conformance.test.mjs. Rolling a rule out to every active repo is part of the same work (AGENT-RULES, « A rule reaches every repo »); `node scripts/conformance-fanout.mjs` opens the conforming pull request in each red repo.
checks: workflow-calls {workflows | byKind} | workflow-matches {pattern} | workflow-forbids {pattern} | file-exists {paths} | file-matches {path, pattern} | manifests-forbid {pattern} | published-no-mention {pattern, allow}: no file of the latest npm tarball of a public package of the repository matches (built CSS/JS included; `allow`: history files such as CHANGELOG.md) | no-mention {pattern, allow, allowIn}: no tracked text file matches the pattern (path prefixes in `allow`, or in `allowIn[repo]`, are history). `applies`: kinds, notRepos, onlyRepos, when [{pathEndsWith}|{fileExists}|{fileMatches}|{inList}]. `fix`: copy {from, to} | append-section {file, from, heading} | manual {note}.
